newsitem.title: GREECE: Papandoniou economic "czar" in Greek cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Papandoniou economic "czar" in Greek cabinet.

text.p: Socialist Prime Minister Costas Simitis kept Yannos Papandoniou as Greece's national economy minister on Tuesday and elevated him to finance minister as well.

Sticking with proven hands, Simitis renamed Vasso Papandreou as development minister in his new cabinet and kept Theodoros Pangalos as foreign minister. Old-guard socialist Akis Tsohatzopoulos took over as new defence minister.
George Papandreou, son of late socialist party founder Andreas Papandreou, was named deputy foreign minister, leaving the education ministry after three years.
Alexandros Papadopoulos, a respected finance minister since 1993, moved to the interior ministry, replacing Tsohatzopoulos.

Simitis won a convincing national election victory on Sunday over the opposition conservatives. His new cabinet is a mix of old-guard socialists and a younger generation of reformers who helped put him in power.
